digest.component_or_area: LLM verdict signing and provenance recording
propositions: Signed verdicts currently record only a model string and do not distinguish between first-class provider, best-effort tier, or opaque gateway endpoints, making it impossible for consumers to validate verdict provenance.

An additive `provider_provenance` object must be assembled in capabilities.py and threaded through runner.py reusing the once-computed capabilities record, then populated into all three sidecar payloads (plan_review, completion, code_review) without breaking backward compatibility.

The `endpoint_host` field must extract hostname only via `urlparse(base_url).hostname` to strip credentials, and the persisted payload must contain neither userinfo from base_url nor api_key material anywhere.

The tier field must be semantically defined as `first_class` (direct provider) or `best_effort` (custom base_url), and populated by finalize_verdict in all reachable call sites that have a runner result carrying the assembled provenance record.
